title: Allow 5-minute tracking updates for Hartline's yard system
text: Hartline is rolling out a new yard management system at the Tacoma DC that assigns dock doors from live truck positions, and their IT team says our tracking feed is too coarse for it. They need a position every 5 minutes for inbound loads. Example: an inbound load checked in at pickup at 13:00 and checked out at the DC at 14:00 should post 13 positions (13:00, 13:05, ... 14:00), and today we post 5. Calling `share_schedule` in `tracking.py` with a 5-minute interval raises a ValueError. Can we lower the minimum so `share_schedule` accepts a 5-minute interval? Their go-live is November 9 and we are the first carrier they are integrating.
